nodes.description: Packed pool reserves (uint112 reserveStock | uint112 reserveMoney | uint32 firstSellID) written by _setReserves/sync/mint/burn and read by getReserves.
Packed orderbook-booked amounts and firstBuyID (uint112 bookedStock | uint112 bookedMoney | uint32 firstBuyID) written by _setBooked.
Last invariant product cached for fee-on liquidity minting; updated in mint/burn/_mintFee.
Reentrancy guard flag toggled by the lock modifier around every external-call entrypoint.
LP share total supply, mutated by _mint/_burn and read in mint/burn/fee math.
LP share balances mapping; address(this) balance is burned during burn().
LP share allowance mapping spent in transferFrom using msg.sender.
Fixed-size sell order book array (1<<22) of packed Order words.
Fixed-size buy order book array (1<<22) of packed Order words.
Protocol fee recipient of the factory, updated by setFeeTo.
Authorised setter address, updated by setFeeToSetter.
Immutable governance address required by setPairLogic and setFeeBPS.
Swap fee in basis points (default 50), read by _dealWithPoolAndCollectFee and written by setFeeBPS.
Implementation logic address used by the proxy fallback delegatecall; updated by setPairLogic.
Mapping from keccak(stock,money,isOnlySwap) to pair address, written in createPair.
Array of all created pair addresses, appended in createPair.
Deploys a deterministic OneSwapPairProxy with CREATE2, registers token/pair mappings and registers the pair with msg.sender as factory.
Sets feeTo, gated only by require(msg.sender == feeToSetter).
Transfers the feeToSetter role, gated by require(msg.sender == feeToSetter).
Sets the pair implementation used by delegatecall, gated by require(msg.sender == gov); affects every pair.
Sets the swap fee basis points (0..50), gated by require(msg.sender == gov).
Payable fallback that appends five immutable words to calldata and delegatecalls the factory-selected implementation.
Permissionless liquidity mint: reads balances/reserves, mints LP tokens and rewrites reserves.
Permissionless liquidity burn: zeroes address(this) LP balance, transfers stock/money out and rewrites reserves.
Permissionless function sending surplus stock/money balances to a caller-chosen address via _safeTransfer.
Permissionless function resetting reserves from live token balances.
Raw token/ETH transfer helper: ETH via to.call{value,gas:9000} ignoring result, ERC20 via raw call with a fallback paying the OneSwapToken owner.
Payable entrypoint creating/matching a limit order; trusts caller-supplied `sender` as order owner and reads proxy immutables from appended calldata.
Payable entrypoint for market orders; trusts caller-supplied `sender` as taker and derives isBuy from inputToken.
Core matching engine loop crossing the opposite order book, the AMM pool, then inserting/marking the remainder.
Computes and applies the amount that can be swapped into the pool at the given price, adjusting ctx memory.
Matches the taker against one book order, mutates the memory order and pays the maker via _safeTransfer inside the loop.
Constant-product payout computation, feeBPS fee extraction, reserve updates and final payout to the order sender.
Rounds a partially dealt limit order and inserts it into the linked list, increasing booked amounts.
External order cancellation entrypoint (plus batch variant removeOrders) reaching _removeOrder under lock.
Unlinks an order, checks msg.sender == order.sender and refunds booked tokens via _safeTransfer.
View traversal of the linked order book that hand-builds the return buffer with assembly.
Derives a pseudo-random order id from blockhash(block.number-1) XOR tx.origin, then linear-probes up to 100 slots.
Price-crossing formula using 192-bit shifts, sqrt and Taylor expansion to compute the amount that can enter the pool.
Verifies the deposited balance covers the declared amount and folds any surplus into the reserves.
Mints protocol-liquidity shares to feeTo when the invariant product grew since _kLast.
Caller address; used for admin gating in the factory, allowance spending and order-ownership checks.
Origin address used as entropy for pseudo-random order id generation.
ETH payout with to.call{value:value, gas:9000}(new bytes(0)) whose success flag is deliberately ignored, so a failing recipient silently loses funds.
Raw abi.encodeWithSelector token call; on failure the value is re-sent to the OneSwapToken owner address, so a hostile/blacklisting token can redirect funds.
delegatecall to the factory-controlled implementation with calldata extended by immutables; the implementation can replace all pair logic and storage.
ProxyData.fill validates calldatasize then copies the last 160 bytes of calldata into memory, so all economic parameters are caller-supplied tail data.
Manual memory writes plus return(addrOrig, byteCount) in getOrderList bypass Solidity bounds checks on the returned slice.
Multiple unchecked divisions, right shifts and Taylor/rounding math (price, fee, pool amounts) where truncation and rounding direction matter.
Order book slots are indexed by caller-influenced ids (prevKey, packed id, pseudo-random id); reading a non-existent slot yields a zeroed Order struct.
addLimitOrder/addMarketOrder accept an arbitrary `sender` instead of using msg.sender, so order ownership, refunds and payouts follow a caller-declared account.
Caller-supplied side flag selecting the buy or sell book and pricing direction.
Caller-supplied order amount in stock units, required to fit in 42 bits and converted through price math.
Caller-supplied token address which must equal stock or money and determines isBuy.
Caller-supplied uint112 taker input amount used as ctx.remainAmount and event data.
Caller-supplied order id used to locate the order to unlink and refund.
Caller-supplied array of packed (isBuy,id,prevKey) removal records iterated under lock.
Caller-supplied new protocol fee recipient, gated by the feeToSetter check.
Caller-supplied implementation address that all pairs will delegatecall after the update.
Caller-supplied recipient of freshly minted liquidity shares.
Caller-supplied recipient of the stock and money released by burning LP shares.
Computed amount of liquidity shares minted to `to`, derived from balances, reserves and totalSupply.
Cursor walking the opposite single-linked order book until prices no longer cross.
Amount tradable into the pool at the current price, rounded to stockUnit for sell orders.
Constant-product output amount taken out of the pool reserves, later reduced by the fee.
Scaled numerator repeatedly shifted by 16 bits until below 1<<192 before the final division.
Pseudo-random candidate order id derived from blockhash and tx.origin, then incremented while probing.
Number of orders written into the hand-built return buffer, bounded by maxCount.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the immutable factory address stored inside the newly deployed OneSwapPairProxy.
setFeeTo is gated solely by require(msg.sender == feeToSetter), a single mutable address.
setFeeToSetter is gated solely by require(msg.sender == feeToSetter).
setPairLogic is gated by require(msg.sender == gov); the gov address can replace all pair logic.
setFeeBPS is gated by require(msg.sender == gov).
_removeOrder requires msg.sender == order.sender before refunding booked tokens.
transferFrom reads and decrements allowance[from][msg.sender].
External removeOrder enters the lock-guarded path that ends at the ownership check in _removeOrder.
addLimitOrder never binds msg.sender to the sender parameter, so any account can open an order attributed to a third party.
tx.origin is XORed with blockhash to derive the order id, a miner/attacker-influenceable pseudo-random source.
addLimitOrder reaches _getUnusedOrderID, which seeds id generation with tx.origin.
tx.origin directly seeds the local candidate order id before probing.
mint reads packed reserves via getReserves and rewrites them via _setReserves.
mint reads booked stock/money to discount live balances.
mint reads totalSupply for share math and mints new supply.
mint updates _kLast when fees are on.
mint calls _mintFee which can mint fee liquidity to feeTo before share math.
burn reads reserves and rewrites them after the payout.
burn subtracts booked amounts from live balances.
burn reduces totalSupply by the burned liquidity.
burn refreshes _kLast when fees are on.
burn performs two external _safeTransfer calls before the final _setReserves storage write (guarded by lock).
skim reads reserveStock/reserveMoney to compute the surplus.
skim reads bookedStock/bookedMoney to compute the surplus.
skim makes two external transfers to a caller-chosen address, relying only on the lock modifier.
sync recomputes and overwrites the packed reserves from live balances.
sync subtracts booked amounts from live balances.
The ETH branch of _safeTransfer dispatches the native transfer with a 9000 gas stipend.
The ERC20 branch of _safeTransfer performs the raw call and the ones-owner fallback.
_safeTransfer performs external calls while the lock modifier holds _unlocked == 0.
addLimitOrder hands the order to the matching engine _addOrder.
addLimitOrder obtains ctx.newOrderID from _getUnusedOrderID.
addLimitOrder validates the deposited balance through _checkRemainAmount.
The caller-supplied sender parameter becomes ctx.order.sender and later the refund recipient.
addLimitOrder loads price/stockUnit/ones/factory from the appended calldata read by ProxyData.fill.
addMarketOrder hands the order to the matching engine _addOrder.
addMarketOrder validates the deposited balance through _checkRemainAmount.
The caller-supplied sender becomes the market order taker and payout recipient.
addMarketOrder reads the proxy immutables appended to calldata.
The matching loop first tries to cross the order against the AMM pool.
The matching loop then tries to cross against the resting book order.
After matching, a limit order remainder is inserted into the book.
The pool deal, fee collection and final payout are performed by _dealWithPoolAndCollectFee.
Matching reads/writes the sell order book linked list.
Matching reads/writes the buy order book linked list.
bookedStock/bookedMoney accumulations use unchecked arithmetic that is only validated later by _setBooked.
_tryDealInPool queries the price-crossing pool amount from _intopoolAmountTillPrice.
_tryDealInPool consumes and adjusts ctx.reserveStock/reserveMoney read from packed reserves.
Each matched maker is paid immediately with _safeTransfer while the matching loop is still running.
_dealInOrderBook mutates the buy-side order struct that is written back to storage.
_dealInOrderBook mutates the sell-side order struct that is written back to storage.
The maker order is fetched by currID derived from the caller-supplied prevKey chain.
The taker payout is done with _safeTransfer at the end of the order flow.
The fee is computed from IOneSwapFactory(ctx.factory).feeBPS().
fee = (amountToTaker * feeBPS + 9999) / 10000 performs truncating division on taker funds.
Pool reserves are updated with amountIntoPool, outAmount and the collected fee.
The fallback reads pairLogic from the factory to select the delegatecall target.
The fallback delegatecalls the implementation with immutables appended to calldata.
getOrderList traverses the sell order book array.
getOrderList traverses the buy order book array.
getOrderList builds its dynamic array with raw memory stores and returns it via assembly.
_getUnusedOrderID probes _hasOrder at caller-influenced ids to find a free slot.
The price-crossing math relies on shifts, sqrt and Taylor divisions with truncation and a DIV_BY_ZERO require.
_mintFee reads feeTo from the factory to decide whether fees are on.
_mintFee compares the current product root against _kLast and may zero it.
_mintFee mints fee liquidity using totalSupply.
createPair records the new pair under keccak(stock,money,isOnlySwap).
createPair appends the new pair to allPairs.
createPair deploys the OneSwapPairProxy whose fallback becomes the pair entrypoint.
setPairLogic writes the implementation address used by every pair proxy.
setFeeBPS writes the fee denominator used for every swap payout.
setFeeTo writes the protocol fee recipient used by _mintFee.
setFeeToSetter rewrites the sole gatekeeper of the factory admin functions.
isBuy selects the order book side and the price direction used to build the order.
amount must satisfy (amount >> 42) == 0 and drives stockAmount/moneyAmount math.
isBuy is propagated into the matching engine to choose maker/taker sides.
amount is stored in ctx.order.amount and used for insertion and partial fills.
inputToken must equal moneyToken or stockToken and decides isBuy.
inAmount becomes ctx.remainAmount and is bounded by the uint112 balance check.
inAmount is the amount consumed when matching the market order.
The caller-supplied id selects which order is unlinked and refunded.
id is resolved to an order whose sender is compared with msg.sender before refunding.
Each packed record in rmList drives an isBuy/id/prevKey removal under a single lock.
_feeTo becomes the new protocol fee recipient only after the feeToSetter check.
implLogic is written to pairLogic only after the gov check, but then controls all pair logic.
to receives the newly minted LP shares and can be any address including address(0) for the minimum liquidity lock.
to receives the released stock and money through the _safeTransfer calls.
liquidity is computed from balances/reserves and then minted via _mint(to, liquidity).
currID walks the single-linked opposite book and gates whether more orders are consumed.
currTokenCanTrade is rounded to stockUnit and subtracted from ctx.remainAmount under an overflow require.
outAmount = outpoolTokenReserve*amountIntoPool/(inpoolTokenReserve+amountIntoPool) truncates toward zero.
numerator is repeatedly right-shifted by 16 before the final division, losing precision.
The candidate id derived from tx.origin/blockhash is masked with _MAX_ID and probed.
count bounds the assembly write loop and is stored as the returned slice length.
Refunds and payouts for the caller-declared sender flow through _safeTransfer.
An out-of-range or stale order id reads a zeroed slot from _buyOrders, which is treated as an absent order.

normalization_plan.reason: isBuy is only meaningful as the side selector of addLimitOrder and its matching path.
amount is the limit-order size validated and expanded inside addLimitOrder.
inputToken only exists to derive isBuy inside addMarketOrder.
inAmount is the market-order size that becomes the taker remainAmount.
id identifies the order being cancelled by removeOrder.
rmList is the batch form of the same cancellation primitive handled by removeOrder/_removeOrder.
_feeTo is written to the feeTo state variable by setFeeTo.
implLogic is written to the pairLogic state variable by setPairLogic.
to is the LP-share recipient of liquidity produced by mint.
to is the stock/money recipient of the burn payout.
liquidity is the intermediate value minted in mint().
currID is the loop cursor of the matching engine _addOrder.
currTokenCanTrade is the intermediate amount computed and consumed in _tryDealInPool.
outAmount is the constant-product output computed in _dealWithPoolAndCollectFee.
numerator is the scaled intermediate of _intopoolAmountTillPrice before division.
id is the pseudo-random candidate produced and probed by _getUnusedOrderID.
count is the write cursor of the assembly-built return buffer in getOrderList.
